results.title: A dangling pin on a fitted set versus no pin at all
results.evidence: both states print the same sentence: "a fitted set that does not name the featureset version it came from — 'what data produced these numbers' has no answer from here". It is false for the dangling case — that set DOES name the featureset version it came from, and the register has lost it.
